# Monthly System Check — [Client] — [Month]

Run once per retainer month, before the optimization report. Takes ~15 minutes.

## Channels

- [ ] Website chat loads on the live site and answers a test question
- [ ] Lead form (if used) submits and creates a lead record
- [ ] WhatsApp assistant replies to a test message (if part of the package)
- [ ] Booking request flow completes end to end (if part of the package)

## Notifications

- [ ] Owner notification fires on a new test lead
- [ ] Team notifications fire where configured
- [ ] No notification failures in the logs / Sentry this month

## Data & Dashboard

- [ ] New leads appear in the client dashboard
- [ ] Bookings appear where expected
- [ ] No obvious junk/spam leads polluting the data

## Content Accuracy

- [ ] Business hours are current
- [ ] Services and prices are current
- [ ] FAQ answers are still correct (see faq-update-checklist.md)

## Result

- Issues found: [list, or "none"]
- Fixes applied: [list, or "none"]
- Carry into the monthly optimization report: [yes/no]
